facts: Address is 17 Jungang-ro 71beon-gil, Seogwipo, matching TourAPI.
Lists a rooftop Hallasan view, self kitchen, free coffee, reading and rest areas.
Lists breakfast, rooms, shared kitchen, library and shared lounge.
Some rooms have Seogwipo sea views and the property has a rooftop rest zone.
It describes Olle Market, Lee Jung-seop Street, Cheonjiyeon Falls and Seogwipo Port as nearby.
